title: equilabium vesiculare
intro: Equilabium vesiculare, commonly known as "Indian Tickle Me Not" or "Kadukkai", is a plant species native to tropical regions of Asia, particularly in India and Sri Lanka. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Equilabium vesiculare are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, that have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic activities. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various ailments, including skin conditions, respiratory issues, and cardiovascular diseases.
